body:
Hey guys, Im here with a new series that I will be starting up with my channel.

And that gamemode is going to be....



Nebula




I've done a breef explanation about the gamemode Nebula and Avicus to my current viewers.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=s_svwi9JGU0&feature=youtu.be
(Sorry for the "P" Noises sounding like air. Need Pop Filter ㅜ_ㅜ)

My channel is based of Minecraft Survival Games, so this introduction was definitely needed for my current viewers.

Just wanted to put this on the forums to attract some people that want to watch some Avicus related Youtube videos.
